description: Create opening hours: weekly hours in a time zone, with up to six time ranges a day for split shifts, plus closed dates and one-off hours. Give a staff member their own schedule with replo_booking_staff_add or replo_booking_staff_update. For multi-step Replo work, read the replo skill (call skills with name "replo").

overrides.description: Hours for specific dates, replacing that weekday's hours; empty ranges close the day

projectId.description: The project that owns the forms, from list_projects

weeklyHours.description: Open hours per weekday; a day left out is closed
